name: Venn overlap
oneLiner: two or three glass circles glide in from their own sides with their names, their shared edges lighting faintly as they meet; they close the last gap with a soft snap, the part all of them share floods with the accent under a glow, a ring goes out and a pill names the sweet spot
say: when the speaker says the answer sits where a few things meet ('what you are good at, what you enjoy, and what people pay for'): cut in on the first one, the overlap lights on the word that names the sweet spot
